```{r setup, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(glue)
library(gt)

cfg <- params$cfg
res <- params$results

`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a)) b else a

# Return the error string if a result list carries one, otherwise NULL.
err_of <- function(x) if (is.list(x) && !is.null(x$error)) x$error else NULL

# Print a note instead of a table when data is missing or empty.
note <- function(...) cat(paste0("_", paste0(..., collapse = ""), "_\n"))
```

## Scope

This is a **vector-centred** analysis of the VBD CDM. Vectors
(*Anopheles* spp.) are the study subject; environmental, resistance,
bionomics, and case data are all interpreted in relation to them.

## Data availability

```{r}
qa <- res$qa
if (!is.null(qa) && is.data.frame(qa$tables) && nrow(qa$tables) > 0) {
  qa$tables |> gt::gt() |> gt::tab_header(title = "Rows returned by each query")
} else {
  note("No data availability summary available.")
}
```

```{r}
if (!isTRUE(res$cases_available)) {
  cat("> **Note:** `fact_disease_case` contains no observed case rows for this ",
      "study area. Case-based analyses are reported as contextual only.\n")
}
```

## Vector species composition and seasonality

```{r}
vs <- res$vector_seasonal
if (!is.null(err_of(vs))) {
  note("Vector seasonal analysis did not run: ", err_of(vs))
} else if (is.data.frame(vs$composition) && nrow(vs$composition) > 0) {
  vs$composition |> gt::gt() |> gt::tab_header(title = "Species composition")
} else {
  note("No species composition available.")
}
```

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=10, fig.align='center', out.width='100%'}
p <- res$fig_vector_seasonal
if (is.character(p) && length(p) >= 1 && file.exists(p[1])) {
  knitr::include_graphics(p[1])
} else {
  note("No vector seasonal figure available.")
}
```

## Vector–climate associations

```{r}
vc <- res$vector_climate
if (!is.null(err_of(vc))) {
  note("Vector–climate analysis did not run: ", err_of(vc))
} else if (is.data.frame(vc$correlations) && nrow(vc$correlations) > 0) {
  vc$correlations |> gt::gt() |>
    gt::tab_header(title = "Pearson correlations (monthly)")
} else {
  note("No vector–climate correlations available.")
}
```

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=4}
fig_dir <- file.path(cfg$output_dir %||% "outputs/analysis", "figures")
p <- file.path(fig_dir,
               glue("{cfg$study_name}_vector_climate_correlations.png"))
if (file.exists(p)) knitr::include_graphics(p)
```

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=10, fig.align='center', out.width='100%'}
vc <- res$vector_climate
if (!is.null(err_of(vc)) || is.null(vc$climate_variables)) {
  note("No per-variable figures available.")
} else {
  for (v in vc$climate_variables) {
    p <- file.path(fig_dir,
                   glue("{cfg$study_name}_vector_climate_{v}.png"))
    if (file.exists(p)) {
      cat("\n\n### ", v, "\n\n")
      knitr::include_graphics(p)
    }
  }
}
```

## Insecticide resistance

```{r}
rs <- res$resistance_summary
if (!is.null(err_of(rs))) {
  note("Resistance analysis did not run: ", err_of(rs))
} else if (is.data.frame(rs$status_by_class) && nrow(rs$status_by_class) > 0) {
  rs$status_by_class |> gt::gt() |>
    gt::tab_header(title = "Resistance status by chemical class")
} else {
  note("No classified resistance status available.")
}
```

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=8, fig.align='center', out.width='100%'}
p <- res$fig_resistance
if (is.character(p) && length(p) >= 1 && file.exists(p[1])) {
  knitr::include_graphics(p[1])
} else {
  note("No resistance figure available.")
}
```

## Vector bionomics

```{r}
bs <- res$bionomics_summary
if (!is.null(err_of(bs))) {
  note("Bionomics analysis did not run: ", err_of(bs))
} else {
  any_shown <- FALSE
  for (nm in c("feeding", "biting_loc", "resting", "larval")) {
    df <- bs[[nm]]
    if (is.data.frame(df) && nrow(df) > 0) {
      cat("\n\n**", nm, "**\n\n")
      print(gt::gt(df))
      any_shown <- TRUE
    }
  }
  if (!any_shown) {
    note("No bionomics distributions available.")
  }
}
```

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=8, fig.align='center', out.width='100%'}
p <- res$fig_bionomics
if (is.character(p) && length(p) >= 1 && file.exists(p[1])) {
  knitr::include_graphics(p[1])
} else {
  note("No bionomics figure available.")
}
```

## Case data (context)

```{r}
if (!isTRUE(res$cases_available)) {
  note("No observed case rows are present in the CDM for this study area.")
} else {
  cat("Observed case rows available:", res$cases_n, ".\n")
  se <- res$seasonal
  if (!is.null(err_of(se))) {
    note("Case seasonality analysis did not run: ", err_of(se))
  } else if (is.data.frame(se$monthly) && nrow(se$monthly) > 0) {
    se$monthly |> gt::gt() |> gt::tab_header(title = "Case seasonality")
  } else {
    note("Case rows present but insufficient for seasonal summary.")
  }
}
```

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=5}
p <- res$fig_seasonal
if (isTRUE(res$cases_available) &&
    is.character(p) && length(p) >= 1 && file.exists(p[1])) {
  knitr::include_graphics(p[1])
}
```
